title: Bird Count
instruction: Stand still and count distinct bird calls.

title: Cloud Edges
instruction: Watch the edges of the clouds. Find where the light is brightest and where it fades.

title: Cloud Zoo
instruction: Find three animals or objects in the clouds.

title: Contrail Hunt
instruction: Find a plane trail and follow it to where it fades.

title: Dark Adapt
instruction: Look at the sky, no phone, for 5 minutes. Count how many more stars appear.

title: Dew Check
instruction: Find one water drop on a leaf or grass. Look at what it reflects.

title: Far Point
instruction: Find the farthest thing you can see. Look at it for two minutes.

title: First Star
instruction: Wait for the first star or planet. Stay until you spot three.

title: Golden Hands
instruction: Golden hour ends at {sunset_time}. Watch the light change on one surface until it turns orange.

title: Lights On
instruction: Watch the nearest windows. Count how many lights switch on before you leave.

title: Moon Hello
instruction: Tonight's moon: {moon_status}. Find it. Look for one dark patch and one bright patch.

title: Night Sounds
instruction: Stand still. Name five distinct sounds around you.

title: Puddle Sky
instruction: Find a puddle with the sky in it. Spot something up there you'd missed.

title: Rain Orchestra
instruction: Stay under cover. Count the different sounds the rain makes.

title: Shadow Clock
instruction: Mark your shadow's tip with a stone. Wait, then see how far it moved.

title: Sunset Colors
instruction: Sunset is at {sunset_time}. Watch the sky colors change near the horizon, not the sun itself. Name three.

title: Tree Gaps
instruction: Stand under a tree and look up. Trace the shape of one sky gap.

title: Wind Reader
instruction: Use leaves or trees to find the wind's direction. Face it for a minute.
